scope: Newly prepared cases and rounds; historical frozen versions retain their original contract.
case_prohibitions: Only explicit input.forbidden or separately recorded user scope may narrow permissions; preserve the source and freeze it with the case. Do not add new Evidence from GT.
font_expectation: Use any font unless input specifies one; specified fonts must actually render. Do not inherit the old generic-only font ban.
resource_failure: Evaluator/network/collection failure or unknown cause is UNRESOLVED; confirmed implementation failure is assessed against the owning Evidence. Permitted resources are not blanket gate failures.
not_implied: permission implies a requirement to use JS or remote resources
